Otlp.// Endpoint: OpenTelemetry OTLP collector endpoint. Empty = no exporter (no-op). Set to e.g. http://localhost:4317 to ship traces/metrics to an OpenTelemetry Collector or the .NET Aspire dashboard. The OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT env var takes precedence.

ObjectStorage.// Provider: Local (default — writes to disk) | AzureBlob. For AzureBlob set ConnectionString (dev/Azurite) or AccountUrl (prod, Managed Identity via DefaultAzureCredential).

KeyVault.// Uri: Azure Key Vault URI (e.g. https://<vault>.vault.azure.net/). Leave empty to disable — required in prod to pull secrets (ConnectionStrings--Database, Authentication--JwtSecret, etc.).

MassTransit.// Transport: Message transport backend. 'RabbitMq' (default, local dev) or 'AzureServiceBus' (prod). Pair with the matching connection settings.

RemittanceSweep.// Enabled: Set true to enable the daily background job that generates CNAB remittance files for eligible installments. Defaults to false — enable per-environment as needed.

Ai.// Provider: Fake | Anthropic | OpenAI | AzureOpenAI. Default Fake = offline (degrades to heuristic).
Ai.// ApiKey: Set via Key Vault (Ai--ApiKey) or env in prod when Provider=Anthropic. Never commit a key.
